name: Dark Lord Verkins
source:
Queen Verkins is the dragon queen and one of the three rulers of the underworld. Queen Galzra is the grim reaper queen and also is a ruler. Explore the story and lore about Verkins, ruler of dragons. This is a romantic love story between these two in this short romance visual novel.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4112140/Dark_Lord_Verkins/]Steam[/url]]
